request_cases.note: Unsupported phase configuration (PRD #3252 section 5): a planning model with no implementation model (no default_model, no templateModel). The resolver does not fail; it pins the implement request (no model key, source builtin). The Claude executor refuses the run before any turn regardless of approval state (provider runs excepted), since the planning model would otherwise leak into the implement turn.
